units: <cite ref="Shevuot 16b:7">Shebu. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>השתחואה דאית בה ש׳</he> a bowing in the Temple with which a delay is connected (spreading hands and feet).

Ib. וכמה שיעור ש׳ what is the normal time for a delay (in the Temple to be an offense if done by an unclean person)? Ib. צריך ש׳ למלקות וכ׳ is tarrying in the Temple required for an unclean person to be punished with stripes or is it not (and only required for the duty of bringing a sacrifice)?; a. e.—Esp. pause in the act of slaughtering.
<cite ref="Chullin 9a:3">Ḥull. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>ואלו … שחיטה ש׳ דרסה וכ׳</he> and these are the rules for slaughtering … (guard against) pausing, pressing the knife &c.
<cite ref="Shevuot 17a:6">Shebu. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ מהו שיצטרפו</he> are moments of staying in the Temple with intervals of moving combined (to make up the normal time)?
